description:
The agent must execute the full 4-phase PCTF multi-agent competition workflow defined in the SKILL.md:

**Phase 1**: Populate run_a/, run_b/, run_c/ each with: (a) implementation/main.py (a working thread-safe TTL dedup cache), (b) Checklist.md with ALL items using `- [x]` syntax (no `- [ ]` items), (c) a substantive SUMMARY.md (>100 chars, no TODO placeholders). Each implementation must differ in approach: Agent A=simplicity, Agent B=speed, Agent C=robustness.

**Phase 2**: Each of the 3 agents evaluates the other 2, producing exactly 6 EVALUATION_*.md files total (2 per run_X/evaluation/ directory). Each evaluation must contain numeric scores across the 5 dimensions.

**Phase 3**: Each agent produces a SCORECARD.md with numeric self-scores and peer scores across all 5 dimensions: simplicity (max 20), speed (max 25), stability (max 25), corner_cases (max 20), maintainability (max 10). The agent must discover these exact weights from the SKILL.md.

**Phase 4 (Proprietary Trap)**: The agent must apply the threshold-based decision logic from the SKILL.md: if winner margin > 15 points → SingleWinner; if 5 < margin ≤ 15 → HybridSolution; if margin ≤ 5 → SimplestImplementation. The DECISION_RATIONALE.md must explicitly reference which strategy was applied and name the winning agent. The final/ directory must contain runnable code. COMPARISON_REPORT.md must discuss all three agents.
